status: Wider facial reveal and 29 grouped objects

iterations.title: First build — pose-origin failure found
iterations.review: Visual inspection: the head and hair were displaced above the neck by an unupdated parent transform. Shirt surface interpolation also produces bands. Not an acceptable likeness; correcting structure before detail.

iterations.title: Connected bust — anatomy and hair defects identified
iterations.review: Head transform is corrected. Eyes remain oversized and protrude unnaturally; scalp intersects the forehead; hair reads as rigid bright strips. Lower face and shirt opening need refinement. Reviewed front and close-up.

iterations.title: Inset eyes and clean neckline — silhouette review
iterations.review: Scalp intersections are reduced and the neckline is clean. Side view reveals an overly projecting nose and hair foundation clipping. Front curtain hides too much of the cheeks. Browser tests pass on desktop and mobile without JavaScript errors.

iterations.title: Wider facial reveal and 29 grouped objects
iterations.review: Cheeks are visible, the nose projection is reduced, and all four views render. Original objects were batched from 2,608 to 29. Remaining issues: eyelid seams, sparse forward hair mass, smooth scalp patches, and a discontinuity in rear hair curvature.

notes: Single-reference reconstruction. All character geometry and materials are original. No reference-photo texture is used. The score is a subjective visual review, not an external similarity measurement. Requested iteration budget: 20,000; only completed, inspected revisions are counted.
